nodes.description: Internal owner address, set to msg.sender in GamyFi constructor; controls privileged functions.
Private address of the Ferrum bot protection contract invoked via low-level call in checkBots.
Public address of the Uniswap pair computed in the constructor and passed to bot protection.
Public mapping holding token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in approve and constructor, decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Public total supply constant-like value of 5,000,000e18 set at deployment.
IUniswapV2Router02 instance used for addLiquidityETH.
WETH address used as token pair counterpart for pairFor.
Public constant decimals (18).
Private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 implementation.
Private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 implementation.
Private total supply of the abstract ERC20 implementation.
Modifier that performs a low-level call to botProtection with selector 0x15274141 and requires a true result.
Payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; updates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and emits Transfer.
Payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emitting Approval.
Owner-restricted function executing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only liquidity listing function that sets balances, calls addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline and distributes tokens in a loop.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
GamyFi constructor: sets owner, computes uniPair via pairFor and grants infinite allowances.
BotProtected constructor storing the botProtection address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances, transfers and approvals.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as the swap deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Low-level call with abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141, _from, _to, uniPair, _value) to an external contract; return value is only partially checked.
Unchecked delegatecall to a caller-supplied address a with caller-supplied calldata b.
External value-bearing call to the Uniswap router forwarding msg.value and eth reserves.

Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.

Spender address parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate used as delegatecall target.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Amount of tokens assigned to the contract balance and used as liquidity token amount in list.
Array of recipient addresses for the loop distribution in list.
Array of token amounts distributed in list.
Constructor parameter holding the bot protection contract address.
Loop counter used to iterate over _tos and _amounts in list.

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as the _from argument when transfer delegates to transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as _from and as the allowance spender inside transferFrom.
msg.sender keys allowance[msg.sender][_spender] in approve.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), an ownership based access control check.
list is restricted to the owner through require(msg.sender == owner).
owner is initialized from msg.sender in the constructor.
block.timestamp influences the swap deadline inside list, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_from is encoded into the low-level bot protection call arguments.
_to is encoded into the low-level bot protection call arguments.
_value is encoded into the low-level bot protection call arguments.
uniPair state variable is passed as the pair argument of the bot protection call.
checkBots modifier executes the low-level call to botProtection.
checkBots modifier wraps the body of transferFrom.
External call to botProtection occurs before balance and allowance state updates, enabling reentrancy into transferFrom.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction on allowance and balances in Solidity 0.7.0.
Unchecked decrement/increment of balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
Unchecked decrement of allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and mutates the allowance mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b).
Parameter a supplies the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b supplies the delegatecall calldata.
list invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with value.
External value-bearing router call can reenter the list function while balances are being distributed.
_numList is passed as amountTokenDesired to addLiquidityETH.
list writes balanceOf entries for the contract, owner and recipients.
_tos recipients are iterated and credited in the loop.
_amounts values are assigned to balanceOf in the loop.
Loop index i controls iteration over recipients and amounts.
GamyFi constructor calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair.
pairFor returns the computed pair stored in uniPair.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Constructor grants infinite allowances to the router and to msg.sender on the pair.
BotProtected constructor stores the passed address in botProtection.
_botProtection parameter is assigned to the botProtection state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient parameter of transferFrom and should be folded into the transferFrom function node.
_to is only meaningful inside transferFrom and collapses into that function node.
_value is consumed by transferFrom's bot check and unchecked balance math.
_spender is a parameter used only within approve.
Parameter a exists only to feed the delegatecall in delegate.
Parameter b exists only to feed the delegatecall calldata in delegate.
_numList is a parameter consumed by list for balances and liquidity provision.
_amounts is applied only inside list's distribution loop.
_botProtection is the constructor parameter assigned to the botProtection state variable.
Loop counter i exists only within the list function's for-loop.
